name: Palimpsest — BCI Emotional Replay Parlor
description: Palimpsest operates discreet parlor suites in Tier 3 and Tier 4 districts where clients can rent curated BCI-recorded emotional experiences — grief, euphoria, erotic longing, creative breakthrough — extracted from consenting donors and played back at calibrated intensity. Each session is administered by a licensed Neural Sommelier who adjusts playback parameters to the client's implant profile. The parlors are decorated in deliberate analog warmth: wood paneling, soft incandescent light, no visible tech until the interface crown is placed.
story_hooks: A client recognizes a specific memory texture in a purchased grief replay — it belongs to someone they know, someone who is officially listed as deceased.
A Neural Sommelier begins experiencing bleed-through from the recordings they administer daily, losing the boundary between client sessions and their own emotional life.
A corporate fixer is tasked with recovering an illegally extracted emotional recording that contains, buried in the affective data, the memory of a witnessed crime.
